description: Task creation from NML files and zips (skeleton and hybrid task types, per-file errors, bounding boxes, invalid form data) and the transfer of a project's active task annotations between users.

header_divergences.cache-control: Rust sends `Cache-Control: no-store` on every API response (README: cache prevention); Play sends `no-cache` on most and nothing on auth errors. Play sends no validators (ETag/Last-Modified), so both force a refetch; no-store additionally forbids storage. Deliberate.

drop_play_chain_messages: Play appends {"chain": "[Server Time …] …"} to messages of failed Fox chains (debug context with the server time). Rust returns only the error entry; the frontend shows `error` entries.

unordered_keys.annotationLayers: Play's AnnotationLayerDAO orders layers by tracingId, a random UUID per side.
unordered_keys.tags: Scala Set semantics (annotation.tags ++ Set(dataset.name)); hash order for more than four tags.
unordered_keys.jobsSupportedByAvailableWorkers: DataStoreService.publicWrites serializes JobService.jobsSupportedByAvailableWorkers, a Scala Set (hash order); Rust sorts.
unordered_keys.supportedJobCommands: Worker.supportedJobCommands is a Scala Set (hash order); Rust keeps the stored order.
